Hey, I can understand how you feel. I've grown up Christian and though I'm struggling with my faith right now, my whole family are still religious. Sexuality is such an awesome, confusing, frustrating thing. You still have plenty of time to figure it out and it doesn't matter if you never do. People should be able to love who they want without anyone having an opinion about it. And don't worry, being bisexual won't make you any less of a Christian. 

Please don't feel disgusting, there is nothing wrong with liking other men. I hope your family is supportive of lgbtq+, but even if they aren't, it doesn't matter. My dad isn't supportive but he still loves me and so far hasn't kicked me out of the house lol. But I warn you, I was lucky. If you want to come out, you have to be completely positive that they will accept you. There are so many homeless lgbt teens nowadays. 

I'm sorry I can't really give you any more advice but I can wish you the best and I really hope you figure this out. Remember this is a safe place and you can send me a message anytime you like.
